name: Mikurajima (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Mikurajima village emblem in white: a stylised island above three curved wave strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Mikurajima, a village in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1994.

features.role: Mikurajima village emblem — a stylised island above three curved wave strokes
